tier: T0 (GT-conditioned oracles): a diagnostic of how O consumes T's code, never a driving claim
estimator: paired episode-cluster bootstrap, B=2000 (episodes), 141 episodes / 2,399 windows; answers 'another draw of EPISODES' only (H-ESTIM-SEED-1); the SECOND SEED (a new training run) is the replicate KIND's both-seed rule asks for
committed_rule_quoted: train X at seed 1 on box 2 (MIXO's argv, `--seed 1`, behind its launch gate) and re-read gain_k at s1. k is a CARRIER only if it clears 2F at s1 too (KIND's both-seed rule). A carrier gets a T-side arm aimed at it, under its own PREREG, along KIND's routing: SPEED -> T's speed variance; ANGLE, GEOM or TTE -> the encoder (LoRA); TIMEGAP or LEADGAP -> lead perception. Several candidates are ranked by gain_k(X) and all go to the s1 read

definition.JUNCTION: turn_is_turn = 1 at the T-tick label row (a dominant turn segment in the label band)
definition.CURVE: curve = 1 at the T-tick label row
definition.NO-TURN: every other window (includes the windows with no v9 row, where the oracle falls back to T's own code and the gain is exactly 0)

strata.decides: nothing: the committed outcome table and the refusals are unchanged
strata.estimator: paired episode-cluster bootstrap WITHIN the stratum, B=2000, the stratum's own episodes; fewer than 10 episodes: n and no interval

labels.definition: JUNCTION: turn_is_turn == 1 at rowT; CURVE: curve == 1 at rowT; NO-TURN: every other window (incl. no v9 row)

strata.read_with: If the angle / tte / geom gains sit in CURVE windows, the lever is perception of bends (the encoder: it raises LoRA's prior), not a route input. If they sit in JUNCTION windows, a predicted-goal input stays on the list. (PREREG_V8F_KIND Amendment 1; descriptive, decides nothing.)

contribution_to_pooled_gain_m.note: n_stratum / N * gain_stratum per stratum; the three sum to pooled_gain (the deciding gain_k) exactly

beside.families_note: tactical and strategic are identical across the oracle arms by construction (the oracle replaces only the code O reads); lateral / longitudinal are paired vs X's own code

seed_swing_vs_s0.estimator: paired episode-cluster bootstrap on the per-window difference of the two seeds' gains (same windows); the two X are different training runs, so this is descriptive of the seed swing, not a test
